vault/Literature/Papers/Entries/Agent-Based Modeling to Inform Online Community Design- Impact of Topical Breadth- Message Volume- and Discussion Moderation on Member Commitment and Contribution.md
Community settings
choice alternatives in arrays; active_or_inactive; value
choice alternatives use |; Active | Inactive; benefit and cost values are opaque; explicit cost fields and named experimental constants

The guide reserves brackets for arrays/maps and union bars for alternatives. The paper does not define benefit/cost scales, so opaque values avoid inventing a numeric type; fixed factor levels use named CAPS constants.
The paper does not establish numeric ranges/scales for each benefit or cost; these remain opaque rather than assuming floating-point representation.
vault/Literature/Papers/Entries/AgentSociety 2- An Integrated Research Environment for Executable Social Science.md
Platform schema
implementation-like untyped field values and action arrays
compact role/workspace/environment types, explicit WorkflowStage/Skill/Action unions, and one short agent_step procedure
Replace the oversized block with readable type declarations, distinguish ordered workflow/available collections from one-of types, and express the runtime loop with a concise procedure.
Agent internals, context payloads, environment modules, and action selection remain abstract because the paper leaves study-specific transitions and implementation details configurable.
vault/Literature/Papers/Entries/AgentSociety- Large-Scale Simulation of LLM-Driven Generative Agents Advances Understanding of Human Behaviors and Society.md
Model representation
Dense prose describing agents, mind, memory, modules, and runtime without compact notation
Concise Agent/Mind/Emotion/Relationship types plus mechanism bullets for the agent loop, mobility, social interaction, economy, and runtime

The source describes an architecture rather than a complete transition model. The schema makes specified fields and ranges visible, leaves unspecified fields opaque, and preserves mechanism details and source footnotes.
Prompts, individual parameters, study-specific treatments, and offline agent interactions remain incomplete or future work; no shared transition rule was invented.

global_checks.array_vs_choice: Corrected finite alternatives to A | B; retained brackets where the field is an actual collection or map.
global_checks.constants: Fixed configuration/mechanism values used by edited notation now have named CAPS constants. Genuine sampled/type ranges remain ranges.
global_checks.types_and_ids: Added opaque ... declarations where domain details are source-specific; used collection-derived IDs consistently.
global_checks.procedures: Kept mutation/output conventions and corrected the guide example’s undefined return variable.
global_checks.scope_result: No additional malformed one-of array, active_or_inactive, or value pseudo-type patterns remained in inventoried model blocks.

unresolved_semantics: Opaque types are explicitly retained where a general framework or compact empirical schema does not specify their internal fields.

The online-community benefit/cost metric domains, AgentSociety study-specific transitions, iPOMDP task models, and BayesAct application-specific mappings remain unspecified by their sources or this schema.
